paragraphs.text: Shroofus Sproutsire is a legendary saproling from an unknown plane.

Shroofus Sproutsire is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Green Fun Guys deck . He is a walking fungus with multiple legs, a mushroom on top of his head, and two eye stalks. It has been said his laughter is as infectious as everything else about him, implying it may be dangerous for other living creatures to be near him despite his seemingly friendly nature.
